info.title: PowerReview.Cli
info.description: PR review management CLI tool. Manage draft comments, submit reviews, and sync threads across Azure DevOps (and GitHub in the future).

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: PowerReview — PR review management CLI tool

commands.name: open
commands.description: Open a review for a pull request. Fetches PR data, sets up git, creates/resumes session.

options.name: --repo-path
options.description: Path to an existing local git repository

options.name: --auto-clone
options.description: Automatically clone the repository if the repo path doesn't exist [default: False]

commands.name: session
commands.description: Get session info for a PR. No auth required.

options.name: --if-modified-since
options.description: Only return session if updated after this ISO timestamp

options.name: --path-only
options.description: Only output the session file path [default: False]

commands.name: files
commands.description: List changed files in a PR session. No auth required.

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Get the unified diff for a file in a PR session. No auth required.

options.name: --file
options.description: File path to get diff info for

commands.name: threads
commands.description: List comment threads in a PR session. No auth required.

commands.name: thread-status
commands.description: Update the status of a comment thread. Auth required.

options.name: --thread-id
options.description: The remote thread ID to update

options.name: --status
options.description: New thread status: active, fixed, wontfix, closed, bydesign, pending

commands.name: comment
commands.description: Manage draft comments. No auth required.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a new draft comment

options.name: --body-stdin
options.description: Read comment body from stdin [default: False]

options.name: --author-name
options.description: Display name for the comment author (e.g. 'SecurityReviewer')

options.name: --parent-comment-id
options.description: Parent comment ID for nested replies

commands.name: edit
commands.description: Edit an existing draft comment's body

options.name: --body-stdin
options.description: Read new body from stdin [default: False]

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Delete a draft comment

commands.name: delete-all
commands.description: Delete all draft comments in 'draft' status. Optionally filter by author.

options.name: --author
options.description: Filter by author: 'ai' or 'user'. Omit to delete all.

commands.name: approve
commands.description: Approve a draft comment (draft -> pending)

commands.name: approve-all
commands.description: Approve all draft comments (draft -> pending)

commands.name: unapprove
commands.description: Unapprove a draft comment (pending -> draft)

commands.name: update-remote
commands.description: Update a published comment on the remote provider. Auth required.

options.name: --body-stdin
options.description: Read new body from stdin [default: False]

commands.name: delete-remote
commands.description: Delete a published comment from the remote provider. Auth required.

commands.name: reply
commands.description: Create a reply draft to an existing thread. No auth required.

options.name: --thread-id
options.description: Remote thread ID to reply to

options.name: --body-stdin
options.description: Read reply body from stdin [default: False]

options.name: --author-name
options.description: Display name for the comment author (e.g. 'SecurityReviewer')

commands.name: submit
commands.description: Submit all pending draft comments to the remote provider. Auth required.

commands.name: vote
commands.description: Set your review vote on the PR. Auth required.

options.name: --value
options.description: Vote value: approve, approve-with-suggestions, no-vote, wait-for-author, reject

commands.name: sync
commands.description: Sync threads from the remote provider. Auth required.

commands.name: refresh
commands.description: Refresh the session from the remote provider. Re-fetches PR metadata, files, and threads. Auth required.

commands.name: close
commands.description: Close a review session. Cleans up git worktree if configured. No auth required.

commands.name: sessions
commands.description: Manage saved sessions

commands.name: list
commands.description: List all saved sessions

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Delete a specific session

commands.name: clean
commands.description: Delete all saved sessions

commands.name: config
commands.description: Show configuration. No auth required.

options.name: --path-only
options.description: Only output the config file path [default: False]

commands.name: mark-reviewed
commands.description: Mark a file as reviewed in the current iteration. No auth required.

options.name: --file
options.description: File path to mark as reviewed

commands.name: unmark-reviewed
commands.description: Remove the reviewed mark from a file. No auth required.

options.name: --file
options.description: File path to unmark as reviewed

commands.name: mark-all-reviewed
commands.description: Mark all changed files as reviewed. No auth required.

commands.name: check-iteration
commands.description: Check for new iterations from the remote. Auth required.

commands.name: iteration-diff
commands.description: Get diff between iterations for a file. No auth required.

options.name: --file
options.description: File path to get iteration diff for

commands.name: working-dir
commands.description: Get the filesystem path to the working directory for a PR review. No auth required.

commands.name: read-file
commands.description: Read the contents of a file from the PR working directory. No auth required.

options.name: --file
options.description: Relative file path within the repository

options.name: --offset
options.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed, default: 1)

options.name: --limit
options.description: Maximum number of lines to return (default: all)

commands.name: file-content
commands.description: Read the content of a file at a specific branch from the remote provider. Auth required.

options.name: --file
options.description: Relative file path within the repository

options.name: --branch
options.description: Branch to read from (e.g. 'main', 'feature/xyz'). Uses the target branch by default.

commands.name: update-description
commands.description: Update the PR description on the remote provider. Auth required.

options.name: --body-stdin
options.description: Read description body from stdin [default: False]

commands.name: fix-worktree
commands.description: Manage the fix worktree for AI agents to make code changes in response to PR comments.

commands.name: prepare
commands.description: Create a fix worktree for AI agents to work in. Idempotent — returns existing worktree if already created.

commands.name: cleanup
commands.description: Remove the fix worktree and clean up all fix branches.

commands.name: path
commands.description: Get the fix worktree path for a PR. No auth required.

commands.name: create-branch
commands.description: Create a fix branch in the worktree for a specific comment thread.

options.name: --thread-id
options.description: The thread ID to create a fix branch for

commands.name: proposal
commands.description: Manage proposed code fixes from AI agents.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Register a proposed code fix. The AI agent should have already committed changes to the fix branch.

options.name: --thread-id
options.description: The remote thread ID this proposal responds to

options.name: --branch
options.description: Name of the fix branch holding the changes

options.name: --description
options.description: Description of what the fix does

options.name: --files
options.description: Comma-separated list of changed file paths

options.name: --author-name
options.description: Display name for the agent that created this proposal

options.name: --reply-draft-id
options.description: UUID of a linked reply draft to auto-approve on proposal approval

commands.name: list
commands.description: List all proposals and their statuses.

commands.name: diff
commands.description: View the code diff for a proposed fix.

options.name: --proposal-id
options.description: The proposal UUID to get the diff for

commands.name: approve
commands.description: Approve a proposed fix (draft -> approved). Linked reply drafts are auto-approved.

commands.name: approve-all
commands.description: Approve all draft proposals at once. Linked reply drafts are auto-approved.

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Apply an approved proposal by cherry-picking changes into the PR branch.

options.name: --push
options.description: Push the changes to the remote after applying [default: False]

commands.name: apply-all
commands.description: Apply all approved proposals by cherry-picking changes into the PR branch.

options.name: --push
options.description: Push the changes to the remote after applying all proposals [default: False]

commands.name: reject
commands.description: Reject a proposed fix (draft -> rejected).

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Delete a proposed fix (only draft or rejected proposals).
